title: Please Stay on This Page
blurb: A very simple web page: one button, and a calm narrator who explains, a little too carefully, what you're meant to do next. Then the narrator starts noticing what you do with the browser itself: switching tabs, resizing, sitting still, right-clicking, highlighting, scrolling past the end. The page peels back to its scaffolding, its 1998 self, or a comments section. Twelve endings, and it remembers you.
